summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching its unaudited Q3 2026 interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A and Canadian-law CEO/CFO certifications for the period ended September 30, 2026. The report is a routine quarterly periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 shelf. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms are stated; only ordinary financial position data such as $23.5bn total assets and share-classified financial liabilities of $5.2bn appear. Not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
